summary_en: Remixpoint authorized repurchase of up to 8.0 million shares (5.4% of outstanding shares) for maximum 2.0 billion yen through market purchase on Tokyo Stock Exchange from October 1, 2026 to March 31, 2027, with minimum execution target of 1.0 billion yen to enhance capital efficiency and per-share shareholder value alongside growth investments.
title_en: Notice Regarding Resolution on Matters Related to Acquisition of Treasury Stock (Acquisition of Treasury Stock Based on Articles of Incorporation Pursuant to Article 459, Paragraph 1 of the Companies Act)
translation_en_brief:
Remixpoint, Inc. resolved on September 4, 2026 to acquire up to 8.0 million shares of its common stock, representing 5.4% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock, for a maximum expenditure of 2.0 billion yen. The acquisition will be conducted through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange during the period from October 1, 2026 to March 31, 2027.

The company established a basic policy to execute acquisitions totaling at least 1.0 billion yen, with flexibility to increase purchases up to the 2.0 billion yen maximum based on comprehensive consideration of financial performance, financial position, market conditions, and trading liquidity. The timing and scale of acquisitions may be adjusted if material changes occur in business environment or financial circumstances.

The buyback is intended to enhance capital efficiency and per-share shareholder value while funding growth investments. The company cited business portfolio restructuring and strengthened financial foundation following an energy sector transaction announced on August 28, 2026, which will generate additional financial flexibility. Management stated that combining sustainable growth investment with shareholder returns drives long-term enterprise and shareholder value creation.
